The '''Fallowan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fallowan]].
